# GitHub Copilot Instructions for MedTracker

Follow root `AGENTS.md` and its three required local Rust skills. Loco 1.2,
Tera/DaisyUI and PostgreSQL 18 are primary. Rails is read-only reference.
Read ADRs 0013–0016 through `docs/design.md` for accepted fresh Rust decisions;
these supersede older parity, profile-table and per-person household grant assumptions.
No legacy data or credential migration is required. Do not claim planned household
behaviour already works. Use Task, Fish/RTK, TDD and the changed-area quality gates.
